smartFaqs.question: When do Odd Semester End-Term Examinations begin at Amity University Rajasthan?
smartFaqs.answerText: Odd Semester End-Term Theory Examinations for B.Tech CSE begin on December 4, 2026, following Practical & Lab Viva-Voce assessments (including BCS 522 Software Engineering Lab) from November 23 to November 30, 2026.

smartFaqs.question: What is the minimum attendance required to appear in End-Semester Exams?
smartFaqs.answerText: Students must maintain a minimum of 75% attendance in each course (Theory and Lab separately) to be eligible for End-Semester Examinations. Medical condonation up to 5% requires Chief Proctor and Dean approval.

smartFaqs.question: How can I download my Admit Card for semester examinations?
smartFaqs.answerText: Admit Cards are released on the Amizone Student Portal 7 days prior to the first exam after clearance of semester fees and no-dues verification.

smartFaqs.question: What is the annual tuition fee for B.Tech Computer Science & Engineering (CSE)?
smartFaqs.answerText: The non-sponsored academic tuition fee for B.Tech CSE at Amity University Rajasthan (Jaipur) is INR 1,86,000 per semester (INR 3,72,000 per academic year), payable via Amizone online portal or Demand Draft.

smartFaqs.question: What is the deadline and late fee policy for semester fee payment?
smartFaqs.answerText: Semester fees must be deposited within 15 days of semester commencement. A late fee of INR 500 per week applies thereafter up to 4 weeks.

smartFaqs.question: What are the hostel fees and room options at Amity University Rajasthan?
smartFaqs.answerText: On-campus AC Triple-Sharing Hostel fee is INR 1,10,000 per year and Non-AC Triple-Sharing is INR 75,000 per year (excluding mess charges of INR 48,000/year). Wi-Fi, 24x7 security, and infirmary are included.

smartFaqs.question: What are the campus transport bus routes from Jaipur city?
smartFaqs.answerText: University AC buses operate daily from Vaishali Nagar, Mansarovar, Raja Park, Malviya Nagar, and Vidhyadhar Nagar to the Kant Kalwar (NH-11C) campus. Annual transport fee is INR 34,000.

smartFaqs.question: What is the eligibility criteria for admission to B.Tech CSE?
smartFaqs.answerText: Candidates require a minimum of 60% aggregate in Class XII with Physics, Mathematics, and Chemistry/Computer Science, along with a valid JEE Main / Amity JEE score and personal interview.

smartFaqs.question: How do I apply for admissions at Amity University Rajasthan?
smartFaqs.answerText: Applications are submitted online at amity.edu/jaipur with an application fee of INR 1,500, followed by online document upload and Selection Process interview slot booking.

smartFaqs.question: What merit scholarships are offered to B.Tech students?
smartFaqs.answerText: Amity offers 100% tuition scholarship for 93%+ aggregate in Class XII (CBSE/ISC), 50% scholarship for 88%-92.99%, and 25% scholarship for 80%-87.99% or JEE Main 90+ percentile.

smartFaqs.question: How is merit scholarship renewed in subsequent years?
smartFaqs.answerText: Continuation of 100% scholarship requires ranking in the top 5% of the merit list (minimum 8.5 CGPA), and 50% scholarship requires top 10% (minimum 8.0 CGPA) without any backlogs.

smartFaqs.question: What are the regular class timings and Software Engineering Lab (BCS 522) schedule?
smartFaqs.answerText: Regular academic classes run Monday to Friday from 9:15 AM to 5:05 PM (each lecture 55 minutes). B.Tech CSE 5th Semester Software Engineering Lab (BCS 522) is held in ASET Block-B Lab-204 on Tuesdays and Thursdays.

smartFaqs.question: Where can I view my updated section-wise weekly timetable?
smartFaqs.answerText: Section-wise weekly timetables, faculty room allocations, and elective slots are published under the "My Timetable" tab on Amizone and on the ASET Department Notice Board.

smartFaqs.question: What are the Central Library operating hours and digital journal access rules?
smartFaqs.answerText: The AUR Central Library is open from 8:30 AM to 9:00 PM on weekdays and 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM on Saturdays. IEEE Xplore, ACM Digital Library, and SpringerLink are accessible on campus Wi-Fi and via remote VPN.

smartFaqs.question: How do students reset their Amizone or campus Wi-Fi password?
smartFaqs.answerText: Use the "Forgot Password" OTP link on amizone.net using your registered mobile number, or visit the IT Helpdesk on the Ground Floor of Block-A with your university ID card.

smartFaqs.question: When do campus placement drives start for B.Tech CSE students?
smartFaqs.answerText: Pre-placement training by Amity Technical Placement Centre (ATPC) starts in Semester 6, and core campus recruitment drives commence from July of Semester 7.

smartFaqs.question: What is the minimum CGPA required to sit for ATPC placement drives?
smartFaqs.answerText: Students with a cumulative CGPA of 6.5 and above with zero active backlogs are eligible for Tier-1 and core IT placement drives coordinated by ATPC.

smartFaqs.question: How do I apply for a Bonafide Certificate or Official Transcript?
smartFaqs.answerText: Submit an online request under "Student Services -> Certificates" on Amizone. Bonafide certificates are issued within 2 working days and official transcripts within 5 working days.

smartFaqs.question: Who do I contact for anti-ragging or campus grievance redressal?
smartFaqs.answerText: Amity University Rajasthan enforces a zero-tolerance anti-ragging policy. Students can reach the 24x7 Anti-Ragging Helpline at 1800-180-5522 or email proctor@jpr.amity.edu.

smartFaqs.question: When is Odyssey, the annual techno-cultural fest of Amity University Rajasthan?
smartFaqs.answerText: Odyssey, the flagship annual techno-cultural fest of AUR, is scheduled for February 18-20, 2027, featuring hackathons, robotics challenges, and cultural nights.
